title: Ohtani Withheld From Sunday Start as Return Timeline Stalls
dek: Dodgers manager Dave Roberts announced Shohei Ohtani will not pitch Sunday following continued soreness. Roberts stated Ohtani is "not 100%" and his return timeline remains unclear, though the team still expects his return as a pitcher this season.
author: The GoCheckMySports Desk
key_fact: Ohtani will not pitch Sunday and his full recovery timeline is now uncertain, per Dodgers manager Dave Roberts.
bottom_line: Ohtani's availability on the mound remains in flux, creating uncertainty for the Dodgers' pitching rotation. The threshold to watch is when the team provides a specific target date for his next appearance.
body: Dodgers manager Dave Roberts announced that Shohei Ohtani will not pitch Sunday, per MLB.com. Roberts acknowledged that Ohtani is "not 100%" and his condition will keep him off the mound a little while longer, according to MLB.com reporting.

The Dodgers still expect to get Ohtani back as a pitcher this season, though no revised timeline has been provided. The delay extends a recovery window that has already pushed Ohtani's pitching return past earlier expectations.
